summary: Auth v2 (email verification hard-lock, Resend, forgot/reset password 1hr expiry, Emergent Google Sign-In UI) — end-to-end tested. 14/14 backend pytest passed (after fixing 1 real backend bug), 10/10 frontend Playwright checks passed. Existing parent regression clean.

minor.issue: FIXED — TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. MongoDB returns `created_at` as naive UTC while `_now()` is tz-aware, causing 500s on cooldown check. Patched auth_v2_router.py to coerce naive->aware before subtraction.

action_items: None blocking. Backend bug fixed inline. Consider audit-logging non-2xx Resend responses (currently swallowed to ERROR: string in emails_sent.provider_id — fine for now).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_v2_router.py: cooldown datetime comparison had timezone-naive/aware mismatch (fixed). Apply same defensive coercion to any future datetime comparison against Mongo-returned dates.
server.py register(): verification-token DB insert + email send is wrapped in a single silent try/except — an actual DB error would be swallowed. Consider logging exceptions to help future debugging.

Resend free tier restricts non-verified recipients to the account owner's address. In current preview, emails to @example.com return provider error but token IS still persisted so verify-email flow still works via direct link. Fine for dev; document this before production.
test_credentials: parent@test.com / Parent@12345 (verified), admin@kidsiqtest.com / Admin@12345. Fresh unverified users registered on-the-fly as TEST_v2_<epoch>_<uuid>@example.com / Passw0rd!123.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users created via register endpoint. Verification tokens & password_reset_tokens persisted in db.verification_tokens and db.password_reset_tokens. Emails logged to db.emails_sent with Resend provider_id (or ERROR: string for @example.com bounces).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth v2 flows verified end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_v2.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_auth_v2.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini uses xdist by default; -o overrides). Google Sign-In is not fully e2e-testable in headless — only the redirect to https://auth.emergentagent.com is verified. Frontend /verify-email?token=... success card disappears in <1.8s (setTimeout redirect to /dashboard); if catching it, use a very short polling loop or freeze the network response. DB uses `test_database` name.
verified_flows: POST /api/auth/register → email_verified:false + verification token inserted + emails_sent audit row with provider_id
GET /api/auth/verify-email/{token} → sets email_verified:true; re-use → 400; nonexistent token → 400
POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token → 200 + new login works + other outstanding tokens invalidated
GET /api/auth/me returns email_verified, google_linked, picture, is_premium, assessment_credits
Existing parent@test.com login + list children still 200 (regression clean)
Frontend /verify-email-required: resend-verify-btn + verify-logout-btn present; unverified /dashboard → redirect here (Protected hard-lock)
Frontend /login → Continue with Google redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=...
Regression: parent@test.com login → dashboard renders with 2 children/3 assessments/198 XP/142 coins
